about: Built by tools/build_osv.py. Buildings, paths and the Mill Pond are OpenStreetMap’s, north up and to scale; which building is which, the restrooms, food, water and first aid follow Old Sturbridge Village’s own 2026 Map Guide. Upper floors of the houses are not drawn.
